answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available. Top-1 agreement is 0.855, sequence agreement 0.344, KL 0.334, TV 0.148 and Token-DiFR gap 0.529. All of these sit at or just past the system-prompted extremes (top-1 0.861-0.908, KL 0.197-0.339, TV 0.108-0.144, DiFR 0.28-0.52, sequence 0.31-0.48). Fine-tuned tops out at KL 0.205, top-1 0.900-0.938 and sequence agreement 0.47-0.64, so it is ruled out. Quantized is far smaller still (KL at most 0.071). Base is excluded because every value is non-zero. The raw-score shift ratio of 3.1 is not decisive, but it is compatible with system-prompted and low-end fine-tuned.
